description: Three independently prompted residents, bounded conversations, private memory, dynamic plans and sleep/wake continuity. No scripted future choices.
limitations: Development pilot, not paper-scale or held-out evidence. Seeded biography and rhythm preferences are declared initial conditions.
scenarioChanges: v2 uses plausible long work batches, meal durations and a public resting affordance. They are initial conditions, not scripted actions. v1 failures remain recorded.
